verdicts.reason: A and B look pixel-identical. Each is a near-uniform scale of the square original into 300x250 with no real rearrangement. At this size the 'THE ULTRA TASTING TEAM' attribution, the SOLSTICE label on the can and the logo blocks are too small to read. The orphaned word 'soon.' carries over from the original, and the can sits close to the bottom edge inside the purple circle. The structure is acceptable, but the small text needs to be fixed before this ships.
